body.summary: CPU 3 on \TORBANK halted at 11:52:04 during the Black Friday peak. ATM-AUTH lost its servers on CPU 3 and CPU 5 absorbed the $PM1 takeover plus the noon statement batch, pushing ATM p95 to 912 ms.
body.impact: ATM authorization p95 above band for about 6 minutes (peak 912 ms, timeouts peak 3.1%). POS unaffected beyond band.
body.timeline_md:
- 11:52:04 CPU 3 down (OMF 103)
- 11:52:05 Situation opened; INC-0001
- 11:52:09 Auto checks: meas.cpu_busy, pathcom.status_server
- 11:54:10 Priya approved TMFCOM; STATUS AUDITTRAIL (31%)
- 11:56:41 SUSPEND $STMT1 (Priya)
- 11:57:30 NUMSTATIC 28 (Priya ✓ Sam ✓)
- 11:59:30 Verified: ATM p95 in band for 60 s
body.cause: Loss of CPU 3 removed 4 ATM-AUTH servers while CPU 5 carried the noon statement batch: capacity loss after a CPU failure.
follow_ups: After hardware repair, set NUMSTATIC back to 20
Rebalance server classes before the next peak (C-016)
